privacyPolicy.description:
Once this feature is enabled, the system will support local models and cloud models to analyze files. The local model reads file data, generates a summary, and provides recommendations for categorizing and organizing files based on the summary. Cloud AI services offer file organization plans and optimization solutions based on file data. After you apply the plan, the system will automatically organize the files accordingly.

During this process, the local model processes files directly on your device and does not upload any file data. Cloud AI services may securely transmit certain file information to their providers. Transmitted data may include file names, file paths, file types, file sizes, creation or modification dates, and photo or video metadata (such as recording time, location, or device model).

Note:
The local model is currently in use by default. You can select the model type (local model or cloud model) in the interface, or disable this feature anytime via "Model Manager > Model Management > Large Language Models > Cloud model > Supported model"
privacyPolicy.modalTitle: Data security notice for intelligent organization
privacyPolicy.nativeModelDescription:
Once this feature is enabled, the system will support local model file analysis. The local model reads file data, generates a summary, and provides recommendations for categorizing and organizing files based on the summary. After you apply the plan, the system will automatically organize the files accordingly.

During this process, the local model processes files directly on your device and does not upload any file data.

Note:
The local model is currently in use. You can disable this feature at any time via "Model Manager > Model Management > Large Language Models > Local model"
privacyPolicy.normalUserModelDescription:
Once this feature is enabled, the system will support file analysis using local models. The local model can read file content to generate summaries and provide suggestions for file categorization and organization based on those summaries. Once you apply the organization plan, the system will automatically organize your files.

During this process, the local model processes files on your device and does not upload file content.
